source: os_scheduling_deep_dive_report.md (static ROM/disassembly verification + SH-2E emulator dynamic traces: boot->idle, IVT 0x2c8/0x378, 0x9630 post, 0x96de dequeue)

00005b3c.evidence: IVT 0x7fc50+0x2c8 -> trampoline 0x2ec0 -> handler (ROM bytes verified); clears TSR10=0xb then calls 0x75f4/0xd716/0xcf96. Emulator trace on cpu.interrupt(0x2c8): 0x3238->0x5b3c->0x75f4->0x7b58->0xd716->0xcf96->0x3280->rte->idle 0x3dac.

000075f4.evidence: Body of the CMI10B tick: sync check (0x7f22/0x7b90), crank capture poll 0x77f0, edge bookkeeping 0x7be4/0x80f0, then rearm via 0x7b58. In the 0x2c8 interrupt trace.

00007b58.evidence: OCR10B = tbl 0xd76d[0xffff9f95*2] & 0x7f, TCNT10B = 0, mirrors value to 0xffff9fc3 (decompiled + ROM table bytes). Per-sector tick interval.

0000787a.evidence: 0xffff9f95 = tbl 0xd76c[0xffff9f95*2] (next sector, wrap 0x24 = 36 sectors/720deg), plus period/angle accumulators 0xffff9fbc/9fc1/9fc2/9fc5; re-init if > 0x24.

0000cf96.evidence: CMI10B sub-handler: matches sector 0xffff9f95 against edge table, reads ICR0AH, computes period 0xffffa3cc into ring 0xffffa390 (x 6666666.0), posts via 0xa156 on match.

0000a156.evidence: Thunk: 0x9630(1, 9, arg) (disasm 0xa156: mov #9,r5; pool 0xa1fc = 0x9630) -> group1 rec[9] @0xd98c {id=2, n=1, handler=0x11c98} posted to queue slot 2.

00005f1c.evidence: Posts 5-word {handler, arg1..4} message into queue slot: buf = ROM 0xd74c+8*slot, state at 0xffff9304+3*slot {wr, rd, count}, depth from ROM record; returns 2 if full. Dynamic: 0x9630(1,9,{0xdeadbeef}) wrote {0x11c98, 0xdeadbeef,0,0,0} at 0xffff94a0, count 0->1, wr 0->1, r0=0; then 0x6010 dequeued (rd 0->1, count 1->0).

000039ba.evidence: Appends task id to ready ring at ctrl+0x24 (0xffff74a0)[tail], sets class bitmap 0xffff7668 (bit tbl 0x3d48[class&7] in byte class>>3), and if class > ctrl[0] (cmp/hi, unsigned) sets ctrl[0]=class, ctrl+6=task (disasm 0x39f6-0x3a00). Dynamic: bitmap 0x11000000 -> 0x15000000 on post to slot 2 (class 2).

00003854.evidence: Decrements credit byte ctx[3] of target task (PTR_DAT_00004994[slot*4][3]; disasm 0x3878-0x3888) then calls 0x39ba; may context-switch via 0x3bf4. Dynamic: task[3] ctx[3] 0x1e -> 0x1d on post.

00003bf4.evidence: Saves ctx ptr to ctrl+0xc, writes state 4, calls os_dispatch_next_task (0x3c68); called from 0x3db0 (ISR-exit wake) and 0x3854.

00009c86.evidence: CAN RX IVT 0x378 -> trampoline 0x31c0 -> 0x5e78 thunk -> 0x9c86; dynamic trace: 0x9c86 calls 0x9630(1,12,0xffff7394) (grp1 rec[12] target -1 -> inline 0x11d88 CAN poll) which moved injected 0x7e0 frame into UDS buffer 0xffffddc8.

000062a0.evidence: Task-table rec[0] entry (ROM 0x4998 = 0x62a0); do-while(true) calling 18 functions, never calls taskEnd - the never-yielding background loop; dispatch parks in idle 0x3dac when ctrl+6 == -1.

0000969e.evidence: Task rec[1] entry: os_queue_dequeue_record(0, &0xffffa118); if r0==0 call msg.handler(msg.args); then taskEnd 0x3d58.

000096de.evidence: Task rec[3] entry: dequeue slot 2 (&0xffffa140) -> call handler -> taskEnd. Dynamically run: dequeued posted {0x11c98, arg}, executed handler 0x11c98 -> 0x287aa -> 0x3db0 -> 0x3a0bc -> 0x3d58 -> 0x3c2a -> idle.

000096fe.evidence: Task rec[4] entry: dequeue slot 3 (&0xffffa154) -> call handler -> taskEnd.

00011534.evidence: 29-call slow/background task: 0x2e5c6, ref_calculateTorqueRelatedParams, 0x38f3e, 0x21186, candidate_timing_retard_fast_task, ..., ref_calculateDiagModeTimer 0x55d42, ref_runImmoRelatedCounter, ..., 0x2a290, 0x16b50.

00011c98.evidence: Group-1 record[9] handler (ROM 0xd98c); posted by crank tick path (0xcf96 -> 0xa156); calls 0x287aa (fuel/load update chain) and 0x3a0bc. Executed dynamically via consumer task 0x96de.

00005348.evidence: Fatal trap for reserved/unexpected vectors: raises SR mask to 0xe0 (ref_setSR_PARAM), calls 0xa330(code), spins at 0x535a (disasm 0x5348-0x535c). 98 of 117 real-trampoline IVT handlers + vec 0-63 stubs 0x53a0-0x53c2 call it.

0000a330.evidence: Fatal report/halt core called by 0x5348 with the vector code in r4; calls halt loop 0xa4be (bsr at 0xa300/0xa344/0xa382/0xa3d4).

00005e0c.evidence: WDT overflow ITI (IVT 0x358 -> trampoline 0x30b8): calls 0x5348(0xd6) - deliberate halt; WDT is serviced by polling (0x31c), OVF is flag-only (E3).

00005a4c.evidence: IVT 0x290 (vec 164): TSR8=0xefff, knock_reference_adc_read() - knock reference ADC sampling trigger.

00009630.evidence: The scheduler API: looks up group descriptor (ptr table 0xd87c[group] + idx*8 = {i16 target, u16 nargs, u32 handler}); target -1 -> call handler inline in caller context, else 0x5f1c posts {handler,args} to queue slot 'target' and wakes the consumer task. Upgrades inherited ref_osTaskScheduler. Dynamic: 0x9630(1,9,..) posted to slot 2 and 0x9630(1,12,..) ran 0x11d88 inline from the CAN RX ISR. Wrappers at 0xa0de-0xa22c.

ffff9304.evidence: 0x5f1c/0x6010 index 0xffff9304+3*slot as {wr, rd, count} for the 4 message queues (ROM records 0xd74c+8*slot). Dynamic: post to slot 2 set count 0->1, wr 0->1; dequeue set rd 0->1, count 1->0.

ffff9f95.evidence: Advanced by 0x787a via tbl 0xd76c (wrap 0x24 = 36 sectors/720 deg); indexes OCR10B reload tbl 0xd76d in 0x7b58 and edge matching in 0xcf96.

ffffa3fc.evidence: Set to 1 by 0xd716 inside CMI10B handler 0x5b3c; read by 0xd6e4/0xd70a.

ffff7668.evidence: 0x39ba sets bit tbl 0x3d48[class&7] in byte (class>>3); after boot 0x11000000 (classes 0 and 4 = init tasks {0,17}); after post to queue slot 2 observed 0x15000000 (class 2 added).

ffff74a0.evidence: ctrl+0x24 (0xffff765c) points here; 0x39ba appends the task id at ring[tail] when marking ready.

ffff9fd0.evidence: 0x7fcc appends crank_period_last_ffff9fa8, sums 6 entries into crank_period_accumulator_ffff9f88; rpm = 1.2e8/sum -> engine_speed_rpm_raw_ffff9f80.

ffffa118.evidence: Dequeue output buffer of consumer task 0x969e (slot 0); slots 1-3 at 0xffffa12c/a140/a154.

ffffa12c.evidence: Dequeue output buffer of consumer task 0x96be (slot 1).

ffffa140.evidence: Dequeue output buffer of consumer task 0x96de (slot 2); dynamic: held {0x11c98, 0xdeadbeef, 0,0,0} after 0x9630(1,9) post.

ffffa154.evidence: Dequeue output buffer of consumer task 0x96fe (slot 3).

PTR_DAT_0000d74c.evidence: 4 x 8-byte ROM records {buf ptr, task id, depth} = {0xffff9310,1,10},{0xffff93d8,2,10},{0xffff94a0,3,30},{0xffff96f8,4,100}; read by os_post_message 0x5f1c and os_queue_dequeue_record 0x6010; ROM bytes verified.

PTR_DAT_0000d87c.evidence: Pointer table -> group descriptor bases 0xd9cc / 0xd944 / 0x67d00 (8-byte records {i16 target, u16 nargs, u32 handler}); read by os_schedule_task_event 0x9630(group, idx); target -1 = inline call (e.g. grp1 rec[12] -> 0x11d88 from CAN RX ISR).

DAT_0000d76c.evidence: Byte at +2*sector = next crank sector index; 0x787a advances crank_sector_index 0xffff9f95 (0x00-0x24, wrap = 36 sectors/720 deg).

DAT_0000d76d.evidence: Byte at +2*sector & 0x7f = OCR10B compare reload in ch10b_compare_rearm 0x7b58 (per-sector tick interval); bit 0x80 marks reference sectors used by 0x77f0.

PTR_LAB_00004b34.evidence: {0x37c4, 0x3818, 0x37c8, 0x381c} context-restore variants; indexed by ctx[0] - rec.param.b0 in os_switch_to_task 0x375c (pool word 0x37c0 = 0x4b34).

DAT_00003d48.evidence: Bytes 01 02 04 08 10 20 40 80; os_mark_task_ready 0x39ba uses [class&7] as the ready-bitmap bit for 0xffff7668[class>>3].
